message:
- **You push it** - Instructions: as an Owner/Admin, open each page (Expenses → Transactions, Expenses → Reimbursements, Bill Pay → Bills/Payments, Vendors, People, Accounting) → filter if needed → download icon (top right) → pick CSV, or "Download receipts (ZIP)" / "Download invoices (ZIP)" on the expense and bill pages. Small files land straight in your downloads; big ones arrive as an emailed link to a CSV or ZIP.

Let me know if you would prefer that we pull this service!
notes: Exports run per page and require Owner or Admin access.
Large exports arrive as an emailed download link rather than a direct download.
